title: wilbowes/EchoMuse turns old Echo Dots into open assistants
friendlyTitle: Reuse an old Echo Dot as an open assistant
summary: EchoMuse is an open-source replacement and controller for second-generation Echo Dot hardware, with about 1,000 stars and active development. Recent work includes Home Assistant integration, Bluetooth experiments and updated device software releases.
friendlySummary: EchoMuse is an open project for replacing Alexa on a second-generation Echo Dot. It adds local controls and links with home-automation tools.
whyItMatters: Technically confident users can repurpose older smart speakers instead of discarding them, gaining more control over local integrations and assistant behaviour. The project involves device modification and should be approached as a hands-on hardware project, not a one-click consumer app.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can give old hardware a new purpose and more user control. It is a technical hardware project, so it is best for people comfortable with device setup and troubleshooting.
